svg.aria-label: CASTAWAY: a PETSCII picture of a tiny island
svg.title: CASTAWAY
svg.desc: A Commodore 64 style PETSCII picture, 40 by 25 character cells: a woman in big headphones on a tiny island with one palm. A coconut falls on a hermit crab and walks off with the crab inside; later a sea turtle dozes in the shallows. CASTAWAY is cut out of the sea in block letters.
